name: Auto Rotate Lite
description: Adds an image-style effect that auto-rotates JPEG/TIFF derivatives according to their EXIF orientation flag.
project_description:
The Auto Rotate Lite module provides a additional image effect that can be added to image styles to automatically adjust image rotation according to the image's EXIF orientation information using GD toolkit. 

 Dependencies 
 This module doesn't need anything beyond Drupal core!
